lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲੰਕਾਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਥੈਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ala(n)kaar mil thailee hoee hai taa te kanik vakhaanee ||3||
lines.translation: When golden ornaments are melted down into a lump, they are still said to be gold. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragatio jot sahaj sukh sobhaa baaje anahat baanee ||
lines.translation: The Divine Light has illuminated me, and I am filled with celestial peace and glory; the unstruck melody of the Lord's Bani resounds within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak nihachal ghar baadhio gur keeo ba(n)dhaanee ||4||5||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have built my eternal home; the Guru has constructed it for me. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਅਰੁ ਭੂਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vade vade raajan ar bhooman taa kee trisan na boojhee ||
lines.translation: The desires of the greatest of the great kings and landlords cannot be satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਤੇ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lapat rahe maaiaa ra(n)g maate lochan kachhoo na soojhee ||1||
lines.translation: They remain engrossed in Maya, intoxicated with the pleasures of their wealth; their eyes see nothing else at all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaa mahi kin hee tripat na paaee ||
lines.translation: No one has ever found satisfaction in sin and corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਈਧਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਅਘਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu paavak eedhan nahee dhraapai bin har kahaa aghaaee || rahaau ||
lines.translation: The flame is not satisfied by more fuel; how can one be satisfied without the Lord? ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਤ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: din din karat bhojan bahu bi(n)jan taa kee mitai na bhookhaa ||
lines.translation: Day after day, he eats his meals with many different foods, but his hunger is not eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਆਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਘੋਖਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: udam karai suaan kee niaaee chaare ku(n)taa ghokhaa ||2||
lines.translation: He runs around like a dog, searching in the four directions. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਵੰਤ ਕਾਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaamava(n)t kaamee bahu naaree par grih joh na chookai ||
lines.translation: The lustful, lecherous man desires many women, and he never stops peeking into the homes of others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪੈ ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਕੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: din prat karai karai pachhutaapai sog lobh mahi sookai ||3||
lines.translation: Day after day, he commits adultery again and again, and then he regrets his actions; he wastes away in misery and greed. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam apaar amolaa a(n)mrit ek nidhaanaa ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is incomparable and priceless; it is the treasure of Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d sa(n)tan kai naanak gur te jaanaa ||4||6||
lines.translation: The Saints abide in peace, poise and bliss; O Nanak, through the Guru, this is known. ||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਕਛੂਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lavai na laagan kau hai kachhooai jaa kau phir ihu dhaavai ||
lines.translation: Nothing which this mortal being runs after, can compare to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau gur deeno ihu a(n)mrit tis hee kau ban aavai ||1||
lines.translation: He alone comes to have it, whom the Guru blesses with this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਇਓ ਏਕੁ ਰਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau aaio ek rasaa ||
lines.translation: The desire to eat, to wear new clothes, and all other desires,

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਬਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaan paan aan nahee khudhiaa taa kai chit na basaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Do not abide in the mind of one who comes to know the subtle essence of the One Lord. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਉਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਹਰਿਆ ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maulio man tan hoio hariaa ek boo(n)d jin paaee ||
lines.translation: The mind and body blossom forth in abundance, when one receives even a drop of this Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: baran na saakau usatat taa kee keemat kahan na jaaee ||2||
lines.translation: I cannot express His glory; I cannot describe His worth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਾਲ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਆਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghaal na milio sev na milio milio aai achi(n)taa ||
lines.translation: We cannot meet the Lord by our own efforts, nor can we meet Him through service; He comes and meets us spontaneously.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ ਮੰਤਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau daiaa karee merai thaakur tin gurahi kamaano ma(n)taa ||3||
lines.translation: One who is blessed by my Lord Master's Grace, practices the Teachings of the Guru's Mantra. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੈਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal sadaa kirapaalaa sarab jeeaa pratipaalaa ||
lines.translation: He is merciful to the meek, always kind and compassionate; He cherishes and nurtures all beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: ot pot naanak sa(n)g raviaa jiu maataa baal goupaalaa ||4||7||
lines.translation: The Lord is mingled with Nanak, through and through; He cherishes him, like the mother her child. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੑਾਯਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baar jaau gur apune oopar jin har har naam driRhaayaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਧਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦਿਖਾਯਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa udiaan a(n)dhakaar mahi jin seedhaa maarag dikhaayaa ||1||
lines.translation: In the utter darkness of the wilderness, He showed me the straight path. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamare praan gupaal gobi(n)d ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the universe, the Cherisher of the world, He is my breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਕੀ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: eehaa oohaa sarab thok kee jisahi hamaaree chi(n)d ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, he takes care of everything for me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai simaran sarab nidhaanaa maan mahat pat pooree ||
lines.translation: Meditating on Him in remembrance, I have found all treasures, respect, greatness and perfect honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਨਾਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam lait kot agh naase bhagat baachhahi sabh dhooree ||2||
lines.translation: Remembering His Name, millions of sins are erased; all His devotees long for the dust of His feet. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਸੇਵੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab manorath je ko chaahai sevai ek nidhaanaa ||
lines.translation: If someone wishes for the fulfillment of all his hopes and desires, he should serve the one supreme treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham apara(n)par suaamee simarat paar paraanaa ||3||
lines.translation: He is the Supreme Lord God, infinite Lord and Master; meditating on Him in remembrance, one is carried across. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਓਲੑਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: seetal saa(n)t mahaa sukh paaiaa sa(n)tasa(n)g rahio olhaa ||
lines.translation: I have found total peace and tranquility in the Society of the Saints; my honor has been preserved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਚੋਲੑਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan sa(n)chan har naam bhojan ihu naanak keeno cholhaa ||4||8||
lines.translation: To gather in the Lord's wealth, and to taste the food of the Lord's Name - Nanak has made this his feast. ||4||8||
